_what: Where Messages reads the person's conversations (chat-records.ts): each of `stores` is one place they are kept, read by `tool` with the store's `credential_name`, or with every connection the person's vault names ending in its `credential_suffix` (read by `names_method`, names only), a database without the store's tables being left out. `list` answers the newest conversations, at most $1, as rows of source, chat, last (time), name, words (the newest line, cut short), mine (whether the person said it) and sender. `page` answers one conversation's lines newest first, $1 the source, $2 the chat, $3 a time to read before (or null), $4 the most lines, as rows of id, at, words, mine, author and media (the photos and files of that line as JSON, each with its identity, name, media_type and bytes). Each answer stays a few KB: lines are cut at a length and read a page at a time. A source a noticer tells into `statements` (place message) shows here with no change, as a new import does once it is written in that shape. `forget` (a store that has it) takes one line out of the person's history by its id ($1), setting erased_at; a store without it offers no forgetting. Replying is not built here: `no_reply` in messages-words.json says so.

stores.list: with chats as (select source, after->>'chat' as chat, max(at) as last from statements where place = 'message' and erased_at is null and after->>'chat' is not null group by 1, 2 order by 3 desc limit $1), newest as (select distinct on (source, after->>'chat') source, after->>'chat' as chat, after from statements where place = 'message' and erased_at is null and (source, after->>'chat') in (select source, chat from chats) order by source, after->>'chat', at desc) select c.source, c.chat, c.last::text as last, (select s.after->>'chat_name' from statements s where s.place = 'message' and s.source = c.source and s.after->>'chat' = c.chat and s.after->>'chat_name' is not null limit 1) as name, left(coalesce(n.after->>'words', ''), 200) as words, coalesce(n.after->>'from', 'x') = '' as mine, n.after->>'from' as sender from chats c join newest n using (source, chat) order by c.last desc
stores.page: select id::text as id, at::text as at, left(coalesce(after->>'words', ''), 1500) as words, coalesce(after->>'from', 'x') = '' as mine, nullif(after->>'from', '') as author, coalesce(after->'media', '[]'::jsonb)::text as media from statements where place = 'message' and source = $1 and after->>'chat' = $2 and erased_at is null and ($3::timestamptz is null or at < $3::timestamptz) order by at desc, id desc limit $4
stores.forget: update statements set erased_at = now() where place = 'message' and erased_at is null and id = $1::bigint returning id::text as id

stores.list: with chats as (select app as source, conversation_id as chat, max(at) as last from old_store.w_message group by 1, 2 order by 3 desc limit $1), newest as (select distinct on (conversation_id) conversation_id as chat, text, speaker from old_store.w_message where conversation_id in (select chat from chats) order by conversation_id, at desc) select c.source, c.chat, c.last, (select a.title from old_store.ai_conversation a where a.conversation_id = c.chat limit 1) as name, left(coalesce(n.text, ''), 200) as words, n.speaker = 'person' as mine, n.speaker as sender from chats c left join newest n using (chat) order by c.last desc
stores.page: select coalesce(source_ref, conversation_id || ':' || at) as id, at, left(coalesce(text, ''), 1500) as words, speaker = 'person' as mine, case when speaker in ('ai', 'person') then null else speaker end as author, '[]' as media from old_store.w_message where app = $1 and conversation_id = $2 and ($3::text is null or at < $3::text) order by at desc limit $4
